"""Hand-computed optimization cases with known expected results."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

CASES = []


def C(name, req, exp_status, exp_mlu=None, exp_mig=None):
    CASES.append((name, req, exp_status, exp_mlu, exp_mig))


# (a) canonical example: optimum 0.75, migration 1.0
C("canonical", {"epoch": 7, "node_count": 2,
                "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4},
                          {"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4}],
                "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 4,
                                 "paths": [[0], [1]], "previous": [16, 0]}],
                "failed_edges": [], "budget": 1}, "optimal", 0.75, 1.0)
# (b) optimum exactly at the ceiling U=1
C("ceiling exact", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                    "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4}],
                    "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 4,
                                     "paths": [[0]], "previous": [16]}],
                    "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}, "optimal", 1.0, 0.0)
# (c) needs U=1.25 -> infeasible
C("ceiling exceeded", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                       "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4}],
                       "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 5,
                                        "paths": [[0]], "previous": [16]}],
                       "failed_edges": [], "budget": 10}, "infeasible")
# (d) budget exactly binding gives 0.5
C("budget binding", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                     "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8},
                               {"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8}],
                     "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 8,
                                      "paths": [[0], [1]], "previous": [16, 0]}],
                     "failed_edges": [], "budget": 4}, "optimal", 0.5, 4.0)
# (d') budget one less -> infeasible
C("budget short", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                   "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8},
                             {"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8}],
                   "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 8,
                                    "paths": [[0], [1]], "previous": [16, 0]}],
                   "failed_edges": [], "budget": 3}, "infeasible")
# (e) zero demand + failed path in history
C("zero demand", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 3,
                  "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4},
                            {"tail": 1, "head": 2, "capacity": 4},
                            {"tail": 0, "head": 2, "capacity": 8}],
                  "commodities": [
                      {"source": 0, "target": 2, "demand": 0,
                       "paths": [[2]], "previous": [16]},
                      {"source": 0, "target": 2, "demand": 4,
                       "paths": [[0, 1], [2]], "previous": [8, 8]}],
                  "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}, "optimal", 0.5, 0.0)
# (f) two commodities sharing an edge; MLU aggregation
C("shared edge", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 3,
                  "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 10},
                            {"tail": 1, "head": 2, "capacity": 10},
                            {"tail": 0, "head": 2, "capacity": 10}],
                  "commodities": [
                      {"source": 0, "target": 2, "demand": 3,
                       "paths": [[2]], "previous": [16]},
                      {"source": 0, "target": 2, "demand": 7,
                       "paths": [[2]], "previous": [16]}],
                  "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}, "optimal", 1.0, 0.0)
# (g) only failed path & positive demand
C("all failed", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                 "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4}],
                 "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 4,
                                  "paths": [[0]], "previous": [16]}],
                 "failed_edges": [0], "budget": 98304}, "infeasible")
# (h) history on failed path counts toward migration
C("failed history", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                     "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4},
                               {"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8}],
                     "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 8,
                                      "paths": [[0], [1]], "previous": [8, 8]}],
                     "failed_edges": [0], "budget": 4}, "optimal", 1.0, 4.0)
# (i) budget 0 but history already feasible
C("no migration needed", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                          "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8},
                                    {"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4}],
                          "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 8,
                                           "paths": [[0], [1]], "previous": [16, 0]}],
                          "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}, "optimal", 1.0, 0.0)
# (j) demand change scales history: dem 16 -> a=(16,0); move to (8,8) costs 0.5*(8+8)=8
C("demand change", {"epoch": 1, "node_count": 2,
                    "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8},
                              {"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 8}],
                    "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 16,
                                     "paths": [[0], [1]], "previous": [16, 0]}],
                    "failed_edges": [], "budget": 8}, "optimal", 0.5, 8.0)
# (k) 16 paths, tiny fractions
paths = [[0], [1]]
C("two parallel small", {"epoch": 5, "node_count": 2,
                         "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 3},
                                   {"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 3}],
                         "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 3,
                                          "paths": [[0], [1]], "previous": [16, 0]}],
                         "failed_edges": [], "budget": 1000}, "optimal", 0.5, 1.5)
# (l) empty graph, zero total demand
C("empty all", {"epoch": 0, "node_count": 1, "edges": [], "commodities": [],
                "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0}, "optimal", 0.0, 0.0)
# (m) edges but no commodities
C("edges only", {"epoch": 0, "node_count": 2,
                 "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 7}],
                 "commodities": [], "failed_edges": [], "budget": 0},
  "optimal", 0.0, 0.0)
# (n) reverse direction edge is independent
C("reverse independent", {"epoch": 2, "node_count": 2,
                          "edges": [{"tail": 1, "head": 0, "capacity": 4}],
                          "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 1,
                                           "paths": [], "previous": []}],
                          "failed_edges": [0], "budget": 3}, "infeasible")


def main():
    lines = "\n".join(json.dumps(c[1]) for c in CASES) + "\n"
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/submission/planner.py"],
                       input=lines.encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    out = [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
    if p.stderr:
        print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:500])
    import checker
    bad = 0
    for (name, req, exp_status, exp_mlu, exp_mig), resp in zip(CASES, out):
        probs = checker.check(json.dumps(req), resp)
        ok = True
        if resp["status"] != exp_status:
            print("CASE %-22s status %s != expected %s" % (name, resp["status"], exp_status))
            ok = False
        elif exp_mlu is not None and abs(resp["mlu"] - exp_mlu) > 2e-5:
            print("CASE %-22s mlu %r != expected %r" % (name, resp["mlu"], exp_mlu))
            ok = False
        elif exp_mig is not None and abs(resp["migration"] - exp_mig) > 1e-4:
            print("CASE %-22s migration %r != expected %r" % (name, resp["migration"], exp_mig))
            ok = False
        if probs:
            print("CASE %-22s verifier problems: %s" % (name, "; ".join(probs)))
            ok = False
        if not ok:
            bad += 1
    print("edge LP cases: %d/%d ok" % (len(CASES) - bad, len(CASES)))


main()
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python test_edge_lp.py
